Rapha Singapore Friday Social

Singapore, Singapore · Road

Rapha Singapore Friday Social is a road group ride in Singapore, Singapore. It rolls every Friday at 5:30 am local time from MacRitchie Reservoir drop-off point.

Next ride Fri, Oct 9, 5:30 AM GMT+8

For visitors

You do not need to be a Rapha club member; it is open to everyone. Book on Rapha's events site. Route maps are on RideWithGPS.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 5:30 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: 20 to 30 km/h, faster only on descents.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Rapha Singapore Friday Social group ride

An easy dawn ride to explore new roads, ending with coffee at the clubhouse. The last Friday of the month is a clubhouse edition with Sentosa loops.
